resources.string: RideMate can\'t see Uber, Ola or Rapido notifications, so it wouldn\'t notice when a driver accepts or a booking is cancelled. Turn on notification access for RideMate, then come back.
Android disconnected RideMate from your notifications. Open notification access, switch RideMate off and on again, then come back.
Uber, Ola and Rapido aren\'t installed on this phone. Try the demo to see how RideMate works, or install a ride app.
Choose at least one installed app to compare.
RideMate can\'t remind you to cancel extra bookings or ask you to open the next app. Turn on notifications for RideMate.
RideMate can\'t show its floating button over the ride apps. Allow \"Display over other apps\", or use the RideMate notification instead.
Let RideMate run without battery limits so cancel reminders arrive on time.
RideMate can still open the apps and watch your rides. Type the prices yourself, or connect to the internet to read them automatically.
Pickup is the address you typed
Location is off for RideMate, so it uses the pickup you typed. Check it\'s right, or allow location.
Switch greyed out? Android blocks it for apps installed from outside the Play Store until you allow restricted settings.
This phone has no such settings screen. Open Settings, find RideMate and change it there.
